records.question: Compare Tikrikilla and Selsella blocks on Focus Plus: number of distinct beneficiaries, total amount disbursed, and amount disbursed per beneficiary.
records.sql:
SELECT 
    UPPER(f.block_name_raw) AS block_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.beneficiary_key) AS distinct_beneficiaries,
    SUM(f.amount_disbursed) AS total_amount_disbursed,
    SUM(f.amount_disbursed) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.beneficiary_key) AS amount_per_beneficiary
FROM 
    curated.v_focus_plus f
WHERE 
    UPPER(f.block_name_raw) IN ('TIKRIKILLA', 'SELSELLA')
GROUP BY 
    UPPER(f.block_name_raw)
ORDER BY 
    block_name
LIMIT 10
